note: EIP-1967 slot constants are bytes32(uint256(keccak256('eip1967.proxy.<role>')) - 1). They are recorded here as dated empirical claims: each was read back from the live deployments named in verifiedAgainst and matched the address ledger.json records for that role. A proxyKind that is not listed cannot be projected — see the ledger's proxyKind enum for the kinds still unmapped.

ossifiable.description: Lido OssifiableProxy: OpenZeppelin ERC1967Proxy plus proxy__ admin views. Upgrade pointers live in the EIP-1967 slots; ossification is the admin slot holding the zero address.

transparent.description: OpenZeppelin TransparentUpgradeableProxy. EIP-1967 slots; the admin slot holds the ProxyAdmin contract. admin() and implementation() are ifAdmin-gated, so they are not readable evidence from an ordinary caller and no view is mapped.

erc1967.description: Bare OpenZeppelin ERC1967Proxy. Implementation lives in the EIP-1967 implementation slot. No admin slot is asserted: a bare ERC1967Proxy has no admin concept of its own, and upgrade authority sits in the implementation's own storage, which this map does not model.

OssifiableProxy.description: View-only fragment of Lido's OssifiableProxy. These three functions are defined on the proxy itself, not delegated, so a call that reverts also impeaches the ledger's contractName for the address.
